name: Single column 89 mm (N)
description: Style measured from open-access research figures in evidence set N and the publisher's stated artwork requirements, at the stated single-column width of 89 mm. Changes typography, line weights, palette, legend and axis geometry only. Not an official template.

experimental.evidence_summary: 63 open-access papers; visual review of panels plus typeset-PDF measurements where available; official requirements audited 2026-09-16

derived_from.official_sources: Nature figure guide / final-submission artwork page (research-figure-guide.nature.com; nature.com/nature/for-authors/final-submission), Nature Methods AIP page: 5-7 pt sans serif, 89/183 mm, 0.25-1 pt lines, 8 pt bold lower-case panel letters, 300 dpi minimum with 450+ recommended; accessed 2026-09-16

experimental.width_source: OFFICIAL:Nature figure guide / final-submission artwork page (research-figure-guide.nature.com; nature.com/nature/for-authors/final-submission), Nature Methods AIP page

value_evidence.grid: SHARED:Nature no grid 96%/Science no grid 94%/Cell no grid 96%
value_evidence.palette_name: SHARED:colour-blind-aware categorical palette; corpus modes Nature saturated 39%/Science mixed 40%/Cell saturated 32%; OFFICIAL: Nature figure guide requires an accessible palette
value_evidence.text_color: OBSERVED:axis and tick text black in the reviewed panels; publishers require standard fonts in black
value_evidence.tick_label_pt: INFERRED:398 typeset figures, dominant text size median 5.69 pt (IQR 5.36-6.03), clamped to official 5.0-7.0 pt
value_evidence.axis_font_pt: INFERRED:398 typeset figures, largest text cluster median 6.53 pt, clamped to official 5.0-7.0 pt
value_evidence.legend_pt: SHARED:set equal to the tick-label size (legend and annotation text were not larger than tick labels in the corpus)
value_evidence.annotation_pt: SHARED:set equal to the tick-label size (legend and annotation text were not larger than tick labels in the corpus)
value_evidence.base_font_pt: SHARED:set equal to the tick-label size (legend and annotation text were not larger than tick labels in the corpus)
value_evidence.legend_title_pt: SHARED:set equal to the axis-label size
value_evidence.title_font_pt: SHARED:set equal to the axis-label size
value_evidence.font_family: OFFICIAL:Arial (Nature figure guide / final-submission artwork page (research-figure-guide.nature.com; nature.com/nature/for-authors/final-submission), Nature Methods AIP page)
value_evidence.spine_width_pt: INFERRED:vector stroke widths in typeset figures - modes 0.5 pt (15%), 0.18 pt (11%), 0.19 pt (10%); official minimum 0.25 pt; 0.5 pt floor for raster export
value_evidence.line_width_pt: INFERRED:heaviest common stroke 0.5 pt in typeset figures, kept within official 0.25-1.0 pt
value_evidence.tick_width: SHARED:same weight as the axis line (reviewers coded axis-line weight 'regular', i.e. similar to text strokes)
value_evidence.errorbar_line_width: SHARED:same weight as the axis line (reviewers coded axis-line weight 'regular', i.e. similar to text strokes)
value_evidence.bar_edge_width: SHARED:same weight as the axis line (reviewers coded axis-line weight 'regular', i.e. similar to text strokes)
value_evidence.tick_length: ESTIMATED:2.5 pt, about half the tick-label height
value_evidence.marker_edge_width: ESTIMATED:0.4 pt - a visible but light edge; marker edges were 'dark' or 'none' in similar shares
value_evidence.grid_width: SHARED:grid is off; width kept light if a user turns it on
value_evidence.marker_size: ESTIMATED:corpus marker class 'small' (74% of coded panels) -> diameter about 0.8 x tick-label height -> 20.0 pt^2
value_evidence.marker_alpha: ESTIMATED:0.9 so overlapping observations remain distinguishable
value_evidence.errorbar_capsize: OBSERVED:modal error-bar style 'none'; short caps kept for legibility
value_evidence.legend_loc: OBSERVED:legends are most often absent or inside the axes (mode 'none')
value_evidence.legend_outside: OBSERVED:legends outside the axes are the minority; users move them per figure
value_evidence.formats: OFFICIAL:vector (PDF/EPS/AI) preferred by every publisher; PNG for review copies
